description: Update one existing item (question) in a New Quiz (LTI) by its item_id. Returns the updated item. Only the parts you pass are sent (position, points_possible, or item). When item is given, the whole item body (type, stem, choices, and answer) is rebuilt from it and sent, so pass the complete item, not only the changed field. It takes the same 8 types as create_new_quiz_item. Find item_id with list_new_quiz_items or get_new_quiz_item. Use create_new_quiz_item to add an item, delete_new_quiz_item to remove one, and update_new_quiz for quiz-level fields. assignment_id identifies the New Quiz (from list_assignments or get_assignment, filtered on is_quiz_lti_assignment), not a Classic Quiz ID. Canvas may rate-limit rapid updates, so call serially. Requires permission to manage quizzes in the course.

assignment_id.description: The assignment ID of the New Quiz

title.description: Optional item heading shown above the question stem

word_count_max.description: Maximum word count. Canvas enables the word limit only with both bounds set, so pass word_count_min too; omit both for no word limit

word_count_min.description: Minimum word count. Canvas enables the word limit only with both bounds set, so pass word_count_max too; omit both for no word limit

distractors.description: Wrong-answer distractor pool. Duplicates, and any entry equal to a correct answer, are dropped

correct_choice_ids.description: ids of every correct choice (select all that apply); each must be a choice id

scoring.description: partial (the default) gives credit per choice (Canvas PartialScore); all_or_nothing gives credit only for exactly the correct set (Canvas AllOrNothing)

title.description: Optional item heading shown above the question stem

answers.description: Every accepted answer; all of them are sent to Canvas

margin.description: Absolute tolerance around the value; 0 requires the exact value

precision.description: Decimal places the answer must carry; the value is padded to this many decimals

blanks.description: One entry per backticked blank, in the same order they appear in item_body. The count must match

answers.description: Accepted answers. Defaults to the blank's own backticked text, so a blank written as `Paris` needs nothing here. Give several only with match "any_of"

edit_distance.description: close_enough only: how many character edits away an answer may be and still count. Defaults to 1, Canvas's own documented example; pass 0 to require the exact spelling

ignore_case.description: close_enough only; defaults to true (case is ignored)

match.description: How the typed answer is scored: close_enough (the default for a single answer) accepts near-misses within edit_distance; contains accepts an answer containing the correct text; any_of (the default when several answers are given) accepts any one of them; regex treats the answer as a regular expression

choices.description: Options shown in the dropdown, in order. One of them must be the blank's backticked text, which is the correct option; the rest are distractors

item_body.description:
HTML question text with every blank written as its correct answer wrapped in backticks, e.g. "

`Roses` are `red`.

". The backticked text is the correct answer and what you see while authoring; a student sees a text box, a dropdown, or a word bank in its place, depending on that blank's answer_type

reuse_word_bank_choices.description: Let one word bank entry answer more than one blank; defaults to false (each word is used once)

title.description: Optional item heading shown above the question stem

word_bank_choices.description: The single pool of words shown for every word_bank blank. It must contain each word_bank blank's backticked answer; any extra entries are distractors. Required if any blank is a word_bank, and rejected if none is

bottom_label.description: Label shown below the list, e.g. "oldest"

choices.description: Items to order, listed top-to-bottom in the correct sequence. Canvas shuffles their displayed order for the student; this array's order is what scoring is checked against

display_answers_paragraph.description: true renders the choices as a paragraph instead of a list; defaults to false

include_labels.description: Show top_label/bottom_label above and below the list; defaults to true when either is given, false otherwise

title.description: Optional item heading shown above the question stem

top_label.description: Label shown above the list, e.g. "youngest"

item_id.description: The New Quiz item ID (string, not numeric)

name: update_new_quiz_item
title: Update New Quiz Item
